title: માની દુકાન
caption:
પપ્પા પછી દુકાન માએ સંભાળી. હિસાબ? 'કાલ લખ લઈશ.' પછી એક રાતથી, બસ ત્રણ નંબર. 👇
ScoreMyBiz, 30 દિવસ મફત: બાયોમાં લિંક છે.
linkedin_text: A short illustrated story in Hindi about a mother who runs the family shop alone and never finds time for the accounts, until her daughter shows her she only needs to send three numbers on WhatsApp each night. ScoreMyBiz is free for 30 days on Google Play.

art.style: Warm hand-painted Indian storybook illustration, soft gouache and watercolour texture, golden-hour lighting, rich detailed everyday Indian settings, expressive faces, gentle nostalgic mood.

cast.Anaya: Anaya has long wavy black hair and warm brown eyes; as a grown woman she wears a simple blue kurta with jeans.
cast.Maa: Maa is Anaya's mother, a strong tired Indian woman in her fifties in a blue cotton saree with a small red bindi, hair in a bun, reading glasses.

scenes.vo: પપ્પા ગયા પછી, દુકાન માએ સંભાળી.
scenes.sub: પપ્પા ગયા પછી, દુકાન માએ સંભાળી.
scenes.art: Maa in a blue saree stands behind the counter of a small general store in the morning, on the wall behind her a framed photo of Papa with a marigold garland, shelves full of jars and packets, soft morning light.
A busy small shop counter: Maa handing a packet to one customer while two more wait, a child pointing at toffees, coins on the counter, a ceiling fan, warm afternoon light.

scenes.vo: હિસાબ? કાલ લખ લઈશ, મા કહે.
scenes.sub: હિસાબ? કાલ લખ લઈશ, મા કહે.
scenes.art: Maa pulling down the shop shutter at dusk, one hand on her tired back, a dusty closed account register tucked under her arm, the street lamp just coming on.
A thick old account register lying closed on a shelf with a thin layer of dust and a pen on top, a calendar on the wall with many days crossed out, dim evening light.

scenes.vo: મેં કહ્યું, મા, કોઈ એપ નહીં. બસ WhatsApp.
scenes.sub: મેં કહ્યું, મા, કોઈ એપ નહીં. બસ WhatsApp.
scenes.art: Anaya in a blue kurta sits beside Maa at the dinner table at night and shows her a phone with a WhatsApp chat, Maa looks doubtful but curious with her reading glasses on, a steel plate of roti and sabzi between them.

scenes.vo: રાતે બસ ત્રણ નંબર મોકલો. વેચાણ, ખર્ચ, રોકડ.
scenes.sub: રાતે બસ ત્રણ નંબર મોકલો. વેચાણ, ખર્ચ, રોકડ.

scenes.vo: જવાબ આવે છે, નોંધાઈ ગયું. બસ.
scenes.sub: જવાબ આવે છે, નોંધાઈ ગયું. બસ.

scenes.vo: હવે મારોજ રાતે નવ વાગ્યે, ત્રણ નંબર મોકલે છે.
scenes.sub: હવે મારોજ રાતે નવ વાગ્યે, ત્રણ નંબર મોકલે છે.
scenes.art: Maa sits up in bed at night in her reading glasses typing on her phone with one finger, a small satisfied smile, a wall clock showing nine, a glass of water on the side table.

scenes.vo: અને અઠવાડિયાના અંતે, દુકાનનો આખો હિસાબ.

scenes.vo: મા બોલ્યાં, તારા પપ્પા પણ આ જ ચાહતા હતા.

scenes.art: Maa stands in the shop in the morning looking up at Papa's garlanded photo with a soft proud smile, her phone in her hand, Anaya beside her with an arm around her shoulder.
